dish.title: Roasted Butternut Plate with Farro and Lemon-Herb Dressing
dish.description: Oven-roasted butternut wedges beside simmered pearled farro, with a lemon, garlic, and parsley dressing spooned over the plate.

provenance.process: FlavorWeave Catalog Factory Dry Run #2, Grok Bot only

recipe_version.title: Roasted Butternut Plate with Farro and Lemon-Herb Dressing
recipe_version.description: Oven-roasted butternut wedges beside simmered pearled farro, with a lemon, garlic, and parsley dressing spooned over the plate.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tbsp on the squash, 4 tbsp in the dressing

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tsp on the squash, 3/4 tsp in the farro water, 1/4 tsp in the dressing

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: divided: 1/4 tsp on the squash, 1/4 tsp in the dressing

ingredients.name: farro
ingredients.note: dry pearled farro, not whole farro

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: zest and all of the juice, about 2 tbsp juice, all of it in the dressing

steps.title: Roast the squash
steps.body: Heat the oven to 425 F. Seed the butternut squash and cut it into 1-inch wedges. Toss with 1 tbsp of the olive oil, 1 tsp of the kosher salt, and 1/4 tsp of the black pepper. Spread in one layer on a sheet pan. Roast 35 minutes, flipping at 20 minutes, until the edges are browned and a knife meets no resistance. There is no flour and no breading.

steps.title: Simmer the farro
steps.body: When the pan goes into the oven, rinse the farro and simmer it in the water with the bay leaf and 3/4 tsp of the kosher salt for 30 minutes, until the grains are tender and some have split. Drain. Discard the bay leaf. This 30 minutes sits inside the 35-minute roast and is not added on top of it. Use pearled farro. Whole farro will not finish in this water or this time. If the pot goes dry before 25 minutes, the pot was too wide; this recipe does not add a rescue splash.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.body: Whisk the remaining 4 tbsp olive oil with the zest and all of the juice of the lemon, the garlic, the dijon mustard, the fresh parsley, the remaining 1/4 tsp kosher salt, and the remaining 1/4 tsp black pepper until it looks lightly thickened. If it separates, whisk again. Do not add water, honey, or cheese.

steps.title: Plate
steps.body: Use a dinner plate, not a bowl. Put the farro on one side and the butternut squash wedges on the other. Do not toss them together. Spoon the dressing across both. No cheese, no nuts, no seeds, and no bread.

recipe_version.heat: Oven 425 F for the squash. Farro simmers on the stove. Dressing is not cooked.
recipe_version.doneness: Squash is done when the edges are browned and a knife meets no resistance, about 35 minutes, flipped at 20. Pearled farro is done when the grains are tender and some have split, about 30 minutes. This recipe is pearled farro only.

curator_preflight.detail: Every listed ingredient is in a step. Bay leaf is discarded. Divided oil, salt, and pepper amounts are in the steps. No cheese, seeds, or honey appear in the method.
Olive oil is 5 tbsp: 1 tbsp on the squash and 4 tbsp in the dressing.
Lemon-herb dressing is whisked in step 3 from olive oil, lemon, garlic, store-bought dijon mustard, parsley, salt, and pepper. It is not a bottled dressing.
Prep 15 + cook 35 = 50. The farro simmer of 30 minutes starts when the squash goes into the oven and is inside the 35, not added to it.
Farro water has a small-batch floor. Dressing oil and lemon have floors. Bay leaf stays 1. Squash shops as a whole squash.

scaling_notes.1: Shop one small butternut, about 1.5 lb, not a precut quarter that you roast for the full 35 minutes without looking. Check a smaller piece at 25 minutes. Farro does not like a tiny wide pot: use 1/2 cup dry pearled farro and 1 3/4 cups water, which is above a strict quarter of 4.5 cups, so it does not boil dry. Bay leaf stays 1. Dressing oil floor is 1 tbsp, not 1 tsp, or the mustard will not emulsify it. Use 1/2 lemon, not a quarter. Garlic stays 1 small clove. Squash salt about 1/4 tsp; farro salt a pinch; dressing salt a small pinch off the tip of a 1/4 tsp spoon. Oven stays 425 F.
scaling_notes.2: Half of a 2.5 lb squash, or one squash at about 1.5 to 2 lb with leftovers that are not a second recipe. Farro: 3/4 cup dry and 2 1/2 cups water in a small saucepan (a strict half of 4.5 cups is 2 1/4 cups; the extra 1/4 cup is the floor for a wide pot). One bay leaf. Halve the dressing except do not go under 1 small lemon. Same oven. Roast time stays near 35 minutes if the wedges are still 1 inch.
scaling_notes.4: As written. One squash about 2.5 lb, 1.5 cups dry pearled farro, 4.5 cups water, one bay leaf, one lemon, 5 tbsp olive oil.
do_not_scale: the rule not to add a rescue splash of water

coverage_contribution: Roasted composed plate, plated as a plate and not tagged or titled as a bowl. Lemon-herb dressing is a built compound. Farro-to-water ratio, a small-batch liquid floor, a squash that shops as a whole squash, divided oil, salt, and pepper, and a bay leaf that does not fraction are the scaling stress. HH001 plant meal. Wheat is declared because farro is wheat.
